evidence.title: 重磅：基准医疗全球首个尿路上皮癌前瞻性、多中心真实世界临床研究结果（UriFind®）在全国CUA年会隆重发布
evidence.content:
![f2_banpc-549.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banpc-549.jpg)![f2_banph-115.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banph-115.jpg)

# 重磅：基准医疗全球首个尿路上皮癌前瞻性、多中心真实世界临床研究结果（UriFind®）在全国CUA年会隆重发布

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-clock.svg)2023-02-09

- [![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-home.svg)](https://www.anchordx.com/)
- [新闻动态](https://www.anchordx.com/news/activity)
- [学术交流](https://www.anchordx.com/news/communication)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931891290376.gif)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931892613600.png)

12月9日-11日，由中华医学会、中华医学会泌尿外科学分会（CUA）主办，上海市医学会承办，上海交通大学医学院附属仁济医院协办的**第二十九届全国泌尿外科学术会议在线上开幕** **。**大会开幕式由CUA常务委员兼秘书长**林天歆教授**主持。中国工程院院士**郭应禄教授**，中华医学会副秘书长王大方，CUA主任委员 **黄健教授**，中国科学院院士 **张旭教授** 等嘉宾，会同CUA的全体委员、泌尿外科同道共享这场盛大的学术盛宴。

基准医疗携手黄健主委和林天歆秘书长团队共同合作的DNA甲基化UriFind®项目亮相此次CUA年会。项目核心成员中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院**陈旭副主任医师**在会上做了 **《尿液DNA甲基化和突变在尿路上皮癌无创和精准诊断中的前瞻性、多中心临床研究》** 精彩报告，是UriFind®产品在继《J Clin Invest》和《Clin Epigenetics》两篇权威杂志发表数据后的真实世界验证。本数据**进一步验证了UriFind****®** **在尿路上皮癌全程管理中的真实世界泛化性能；首次发布其在膀胱癌复发监测、UTUC诊断中的优异性能。**

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931893876562.png)

泌尿系统肿瘤是威胁中老年男性健康的常见“杀手”，长期以来，尿路上皮癌患者面临**潜伏期长、确诊晚、易复发、治疗手段有限**等困境。如何才能尽早发现这些泌尿系统隐藏的炸弹并将它们拆除？基准医疗与黄健教授团队从2017年至2022年，历时五年，开发了UriFind®DNA甲基化诊断产品，为我国尿路上皮癌的临床诊断痛点带来开拓性的解决方案。**0** **1**

**全球首个前瞻性真实世界临床研究**癌症早诊早筛最大的挑战就是大规模前瞻性的临床验证，要证明该产品在无症状人群当中可以做到特异性和灵敏度。NCT04314245临床试验为中国企业首次在美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）注册并完成的前瞻性、真实世界临床研究项目。**02**

**符合中国人群的大样本证据**多中心包含11家医院的1092例样本；覆盖华南、华北、华东、华西和华中各地区泌尿领域顶级医院；样本分布与我国流行病学真实分布一致。并且多中心样本检测结果均匀分布、稳定，无系统误差。多中心医院及合作专家包括：**中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院黄健/林天歆教授团队、四川大学华西医院魏强/张朋教授团队、上海交通大学医学院附属仁济医院陈海戈教授团队、华中科技大学同济医学院附属同济医院王少刚/刘征教授团队、北京大学人民医院徐涛教授团队、西安交通大学附属第一医院范晋海教授团队、江苏省人民医院吕强教授团队、南方医科大学珠江医院刘春晓/徐阿白教授团队、南方医科大学南方医院谭万龙/李飞教授团队、四川省肿瘤医院廖洪教授团队、成都大学附属医院杨进教授团队。****03**

**入组样本符合早期肿瘤检测**早期、非肌层浸润型（Tis-T1）样本占比为73.6%，符合临床真实病例分布。**04**

**UriFind®兼具初诊和复诊的“全能”标志物****（1）真实世界数据显示产品整体敏感性84.4%**，比常规方法（FISH和尿细胞学）提高了15-44%；总体准确率85.4%，比常规方法提高了12-30%；特异性与常规方法相当；在健康人中特异性更是高达100%。 **与已发表的两篇文章相比，UriFind** ****®**** **在真实世界中泛化性能依然坚挺。这充分证明了当初选择的标志物在尿路上皮癌诊断中的稳定性高。**

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931894178683.png)

**（2）在早期+低级别肿瘤辅助诊断中**，将非肌层浸润性尿路上皮癌的敏感性提高了20-57%；低级别（LG）诊断甚至提高了4~5倍。尤其对早期膀胱癌，TaLG期膀胱癌诊断率更是常规方法的5倍多。同时对中晚期高级别患者诊断率也是提高了60%。

**（3）首次发布在复发监测中的性能**：敏感性可达80.3%；准确性高达78.5%；可用于术后膀胱镜依从性差的患者；有望每年减少患者复诊的膀胱镜次数。

**（4）首次发布在上尿路尿路上皮癌（UTUC）中的诊断数据**：中国UTUC（输尿管癌、肾盂癌）发病率占尿路上皮癌的9.3%～29.9%；60%的患者发现已晚期，早期诊断一直是临床医生头痛的问题，而活检取材难度较大，术前定性往往需要做输尿管镜检，而常规的细胞学和FISH的敏感性较低，难以满足临床需求。UriFind**®**对UTUC诊断敏感性可达89.7%；准确性高达87.2%；比常规方法提高了22-47%。可减少术前输尿管镜检。

本临床研究也得到大会专家的充分肯定。北京大学第一医院泌尿外科主任何志嵩教授点评： **“UriFind** ****®**** **甲基化技术在低级别肿瘤、复发肿瘤和UTUC中展示出良好的性能，有望每年减少2-3次膀胱镜复查的次数，和避免UTUC患者术前输尿管镜检，具有良好的临床应用价值！”**

**林天歆教授**也围绕膀胱癌早期诊疗现状和方向及膀胱癌早筛的策略两方面内容进行了以“尿路上皮癌早诊早筛的新技术探索”为主题的观点分享。他指出，尿路上皮癌发病率高，早诊意义大，具备早筛早诊的价值。DNA甲基化（UriFind®）及AI膀胱镜辅助诊断系统可提高膀胱癌的早诊率。

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931894481765.jpeg)

**黄健主委**谈到，“为适应‘中国制造’强国战略实施，通过与优秀企业开展合作，实现产学研结合，解决医疗发展中‘卡脖子’的问题，推动医疗**‘高精尖’产业**在中国的发展”。

基准医疗一直致力于**攻克肿瘤早检中的“卡脖子”问题**。早在2020年UriFind®就已获得**中国膀胱癌诊断产品** **“欧盟CE第一证”**；紧接着，于2021年获得美国FDA授予的“突破性医疗器械”认定并于今年启动美国注册临床试验，迈出了**UriFind****®****“出海”的重要一步**；同年开始在全国100多家三甲医院开展临床推广，并于今年完成中国IVD注册临床试验且获得国家药监局医疗器械优先审批资格， **打响了尿路上皮癌早检产品本土商业化的第一枪****。基准医疗UriFind****®** **产品的全球化商业布局已经浮出水面；未来将全力加快在全球市场的准入部署，以期服务更多有需求的普通民众。**

**-本次大会视频回顾-**

evidence.title: 基准医疗SABCS首发：ctDNA甲基化与乳腺超声联合早诊模型可降低不必要的活检/手术率
evidence.content:
![f2_banpc-549.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banpc-549.jpg)![f2_banph-115.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banph-115.jpg)

# 基准医疗SABCS首发：ctDNA甲基化与乳腺超声联合早诊模型可降低不必要的活检/手术率

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-clock.svg)2023-02-09

- [![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-home.svg)](https://www.anchordx.com/)
- [新闻动态](https://www.anchordx.com/news/activity)
- [学术交流](https://www.anchordx.com/news/communication)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931718752860.gif)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931719875208.png)

圣安东尼奥乳腺癌研讨会（San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium，SABCS）于2022年 12 月 6 日至 10 日举行，**基准医疗与哈尔滨医科大学附属肿瘤医院庞达教授团队联合发表的学术研究——《乳腺超声与ctDNA甲基化联合模型可提高乳腺癌早期诊断性能》（Improving the Performance of Breast Cancer Early Diagnosis by a Model Combining Breast Ultrasound with Methylation Markers in Plasma Circulating Tumor DNA），**被本次大会以壁报形式收录，并在会议现场进行了展示和交流。

基准医疗研发团队经过数年的探索发现：**ctDNA甲基化检测在乳腺结节良恶性鉴别方面表现优越，有挑战传统影像学的趋势，有望弥补乳腺超声诊断的不足，减少不必要的穿刺和手术，避免过度诊疗。****1**

**减少BI-RADS 4a不必要的活检/手术，避免过度诊疗**

与乳腺超声相比，**“乳腺癌特异的ctDNA甲基化-超声联合模型”**对BI-RADS 4a类患者的**准确性提高了40.58%**，不必要的**活检/手术率降低了43.47%**。也就是说，如果此技术可应用于乳腺癌早诊，近一半的BI-RADS 4a类患者可**避免接受有创的乳房活检/手术。**

**2**

**区分导管原位癌和浸润性导管癌，避免过度手术****“乳腺癌特异的ctDNA甲基化模型”**对良性乳腺病变，导管原位癌 (DCIS) 和浸润性导管癌 (IDC)的恶性概率预测随着恶性程度和浸润程度的加深而递增，有**进一步区分导管内癌（DCIS）和浸润性导管癌（IDC）的潜力，从而减少不必要的手术和过度治疗。****3**

**更符合中国人群特征的早诊技术，助力“两癌”筛查**早在2021年，基准医疗就在Nature子刊《npj Breast Cancer》（中科院一区）发表了题为《外周血游离DNA甲基化模型用于乳腺癌诊断》（Circulating cell-free DNA-based methylation patterns for breastcancer diagnosis）的文章 [（原文请点击）](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIzMjA5NDM1NQ==&mid=2653540462&idx=1&sn=b6725632abf4477cd602a2d28d40b336&chksm=f3475f92c430d68482d8380b769bbae6d7dd5261cc2482ef9e43903eb9d85293bd093b48176f&scene=21#wechat_redirect)，首次证明外周血游离DNA甲基化检测在乳腺癌诊断方面的效果堪比、甚至超过乳腺钼靶。作为国内首家深入研究ctDNA甲基化检测在乳腺癌早诊的公司，此项研究为基准医疗在**符合中国人特征的筛查方式（乳腺超声）上，对乳腺癌早期精准诊断所做的进一步探索。**基准医疗力求早日完成乳腺癌早诊产品的开发，造福广大女性群体。

**乳腺癌筛查现状**

目前乳腺癌已经成为严重威胁女性健康最常见的恶性肿瘤。大量循证医学证据表明，**乳腺癌筛查可以提高乳腺癌早期诊断率、降低病死率。**近10余年来，随着中国乳腺癌科普和宣教工作的开展，以及国家卫健委 **“两癌筛查（宫颈癌和乳腺癌）”** 工作的进行，女性乳腺癌防癌意识逐渐增强，参与乳腺癌早期筛查的女性比例逐年提高，乳腺癌早诊率也在逐年提高\[1\]。但是，早诊率的提高也加大了乳腺结节患者过度诊疗。当乳腺结节被判定为**BI-RAD4aS 级时**（纤维腺瘤、有乳头溢液或溢血的导管内病灶及不能明确的乳腺炎症等）：指南规定“可进一步影像学检查，必要时活检”\[2\]；但是根据市场调研结果，**90%的4a级患者会行进一步穿刺活检或者微创手术。**临床证据表明4a结节患者**恶性率** **仅为2%~10%**，因此导致大量不必要的过度活检或手术。本研究有望减少不必要的穿刺和手术。

**DCIS和IDC区分的意义**

在WHO乳腺肿瘤分类中，已将导管原位癌（DCIS）列入癌前病变，不属于真正意义上的癌；因此，关于DCIS是否需要被诊断以及是否存在过度治疗一直有争议。治疗方式上，DCIS可以选择保留乳房的手术和全乳放疗，不涉及化疗；而浸润性导管癌（IDC）的治疗方法主要有手术切除和放化疗\[3\]。本研究可避免DCIS的过度治疗。

**关于SABCS**

此届SABCS会议有来自 80 多个国家的 8,000 名国际学术、研究人员和医生参与。该研讨会提供有关乳腺癌和癌前乳腺疾病的实验生物学，病因学，预防，诊断和治疗的最新信息，旨在实现临床转化和基础研究的平衡，为研究人员、卫生专业人员以及对乳腺癌特别感兴趣的人提供互动、沟通和教育的平台。

**参考文献**

\[1\]中国研究型医院学会乳腺专业委员会中国女性乳腺癌筛查指南制定专家组. 中国女性乳腺癌筛查指南(2022年版)\[J\]. 中国研究型医院, 2022, 9(2):8.

\[2\]沈洪兵, 田金徽, 周宝森. 中国女性乳腺癌筛查与早诊早治指南(2021,北京)\[J\]. 中国肿瘤, 2021, 30(3):31.

\[3\]包凌云. 乳腺导管原位癌的超声诊断\[J\]. 浙江医学, 2019, 41(11):5.

**-****End****-**

# 喜讯│基准医疗与广州医科大学附属第一医院、广东省人民医院合作的“肺癌精准早筛技术的研发及应用”项目获广州市重点领域研发计划立项

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-clock.svg)2023-02-09

- [![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-home.svg)](https://www.anchordx.com/)
- [新闻动态](https://www.anchordx.com/news/activity)
- [学术交流](https://www.anchordx.com/news/communication)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675931528269648.gif)

由**广州医科大学第一附属医院**牵头，**广东省人民医院**和 **基准医疗** 共同参与的**“肺癌精准早筛技术的研发及应用”**项目获得2022年广州市重点领域研发计划健康医疗重大科技专项立项支持，获得财政经费支持**500万元**。

国际癌症研究机构 （IARC）发布的全球癌症2020年统计报告（GLOBOCAN 2020）显示，在全球，肺癌每年新发病例约220万，死亡约170万，是导致癌症死亡的第一大原因（18%）；在中国，肺癌每年新发病例约81.5万，死亡约71万，肺癌是中国人群癌症发病率和死亡率的“双料冠军”。**“早筛查、早诊断、早治疗”是提升肺癌患者生存率、降低死亡率的关键。**

本项目拟建立前瞻性肺癌筛查队列，研发基于生物多维组学的肺癌早期筛查技术，并开展多中心大样本的前瞻性验证研究；开发出可用于肺癌早筛的试剂盒，检出肺癌的敏感性及特异性均>90%，以期获得医疗器械注册证，并推动其临床应用。

作为主要参与单位之一，**基准医疗**凭借自身深厚的技术实力和丰富的癌症早检产品开发经验，将在本项目中**负责优化解决痕量核酸提取、肺癌早筛生物标志物的筛选和鉴定等技术，应用多组学降维分析处理方法，整合所筛选出的基于生物多组学的早筛检测靶点，开发新型肺癌早筛早诊产品。**

立项结果公开链接：

2022年广州市重点领域研发计划健康医疗重大科技专项立项结果公开

http://kjj.gz.gov.cn/gsxx/content/post\_8205683.html

目前基准医疗推出**“** **基准医疗：肺癌/肺结节全病程管理方案”**，将为中国人群肺结节患者管理，乃至肺癌早筛早诊贡献一份积极的**“基准力量”**！

evidence.title: CA(IF=286)最新综述｜基准医疗膀胱癌早诊产品UriFind获国际期刊高度评价
evidence.content:
![f2_banpc-549.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banpc-549.jpg)![f2_banph-115.jpg](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Uploads/uploadfile/images/20220726/f2_banph-115.jpg)

# CA(IF=286)最新综述｜基准医疗膀胱癌早诊产品UriFind获国际期刊高度评价

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-clock.svg)2023-02-09

- [![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/Cn/images/icon-home.svg)](https://www.anchordx.com/)
- [新闻动态](https://www.anchordx.com/news/activity)
- [学术交流](https://www.anchordx.com/news/communication)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675930369166162.gif)

2023年1月8日，影响因子最高（IF : 286）的肿瘤学杂志CA Cancer J. Clin.在线发表了重要综述文章《临床实践中的肿瘤表观遗传学》（Cancer epigenetics in clinical practice）（原文链接： [https://doi.org/10.3322/caac.21765）。](https://doi.org/10.3322/caac.21765%EF%BC%89%E3%80%82)

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675930369225659.png)

此综述对目前肿瘤表观遗传学的全球所有临床研究和产品做了全面的综述，其中**基准医疗联合中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院黄健教授和林天歆教授共同开发的膀胱癌尿液甲基化检测产品UriFind**®**是本综述唯一详细评价性能的中国肿瘤早诊产品。**作为膀胱镜检查的替代方法，UriFind**®**侵入性较小且价廉，在应用于评估血尿患者膀胱癌风险中的性能远超临床常规方法尿脱落细胞学和FISH检测。同时，**基准肺癌甲基化检测产品PulmoSeek**TM****，是文章中唯一被引用的中国公司**肺癌** **血液早诊**产品。

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675930370606785.png)

**内容概述****综述重点**

**0** **1**

**基准医疗的UriFi** **nd** **®** **在评估血尿患者和疑似膀胱癌患者患膀胱癌风险中，性能优越。**

综述指出：尿液可提供具有临床实用价值的分子信息，尤其是膀胱癌检测。血尿是膀胱癌的早期征兆，但仅有3%~28%的血尿患者最终被诊断为膀胱癌，因此**对血尿患者进行准确筛查至关重要。**基准医疗的UriFind**®**是一款基于ONECUT2和VIM双基因甲基化的膀胱癌尿液检测产品，于2021年7月获得FDA突破性医疗器械认定。UriFind®**对血尿患者的诊断敏感性为91.2%，特异性为85.7%；对疑似膀胱癌患者的诊断敏感性和特异性分别为88.1% 和89.7%。**

**0** **2**

**文中高度评价UriFin****d®****在早期、低级别肿瘤中的检测性能**

综述还指出UriFind **®** 在**非侵入性低级别乳头状膀胱肿瘤 (Ta)检测****中，比细胞学和荧光原位杂交 (FISH) 具有更高的灵敏度**（UriFind **®** 在血尿患者和疑似膀胱癌患者Ta期检测灵敏度均为83.3%，而尿细胞学为 22.2%–41.2%；FISH 为 44.4%–52.9%）。此外，UriFind **®** 在非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）中，在特异性相当的同时， **比尿细胞学和FISH显示出更高的敏感性**（UriFind **®** 80.0%–89.7%；尿细胞学仅为 51.5%–52.0%；FISH 为59.4%–72.0% )。

**0** **3****基准医疗UriFin****d®****全球首个前瞻性、多中心真实世界临床研究助力膀胱癌复发监测**

综述中还提出NMIBC 的另一个固有问题：5年复发率高达50%–70%，这意味着患者需要终生术后监测。UriFind **®** 在**全球首个****前瞻性、真实世界临床研究**中对于 **膀胱癌复发监测敏感性****可达****80.3%；准确性高达78.5%**；可用于术后膀胱镜依从性差的患者；有望**在NMIBC术后第3和第9个月联合B超替代膀胱镜检测，阴性者可减少复诊患者的膀胱镜次数。**

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675930371763515.png)

[原文链接：重磅：基准医疗全球首个尿路上皮癌前瞻性、多中心真实世界临床研究结果（UriFind®）在全国CUA年会隆重发布](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIzMjA5NDM1NQ==&mid=2653566614&idx=1&sn=18e320f9fe2a864301bf3d330fcd812c&chksm=f344b96ac433307c32465766905369b8aeb83f8396fb57b0acaf8c6da6590ff62b7d95e50342&scene=21#wechat_redirect)

**0** **4**

**甲基化检测可提供新型医疗保健解决方案**

综述总结：表观遗传学正处于最前沿的领域并迅速扩大，技术进步和研发投资扩展了其在肿瘤诊断生物标志物和药物开发中的应用范围。多学科团队合作正在加速此类研究的临床转化：美国与亚洲的商业化程度相当；研究类项目亚洲占大多数，开发类项目美国占多数。作为表观遗传学最核心的DNA甲基化技术，在临床肿瘤领域应用逐年递增；为其提供人类保健解决方案的新征程扫清道路，以期造福广大癌症患者。

本综述作者**Manel Esteller**作为甲基化研究的引领者，首次大篇幅引用并评价基准医疗UriFind®产品，是**对基准医疗甲基化检测技术的高度肯定**。此外，本综述此次被影响因子最高的CA杂志收录，也证明了**甲基化在肿瘤早诊领域不可撼动的主流地位。**

- **关于基准医疗UriFind****®****全球首个尿路上皮癌前瞻性、多中心真实世界临床研究**

基准医疗NCT04314245临床试验为中国企业首次在美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）注册并完成的**尿路上皮癌前瞻性、真实世界临床研究项目。**多中心覆盖了华南、华北、华东、华西和华中各地区泌尿领域11家顶级医院；是UriFind**®**产品在继本综述重点描述的《Clin Epigenetics》和《J Clin Invest》两篇权威杂志发表数据后的**真实世界验证**；数据进一步验证了**UriFind****®****在尿路上皮癌全程管理中的真实世界泛化性能** **；其中包括其在尿路上皮癌早诊、复发监测、UTUC诊断中的优异性能。**

- **关于基准医疗UriFind****®****产品**

UriFind **®** 是基准医疗自主研发的一款基于尿液DNA甲基化的尿路上皮癌早诊产品；临床应用于血尿患者、可疑尿路上皮癌患者、尿路上皮癌术后随访患者；可覆盖膀胱癌、输尿管癌和肾盂癌三大癌种。具有以下优势：

**#** **UriFind®产品优势**

**0** **1** **性能准确**

准确性达89.3%，与金标准膀胱镜相当。

**0** **2****无痛便捷**

仅需采集100ml随机尿检测，更舒适

**0** **3****自主专利**

检测方法获得国家发明专利（专利号ZL2019 1 1370095.5）

**0** **4****专业认可**

获美国FDA“突破性医疗器械（BTD）"认证；获欧盟IVDD CE产品认证，由荷兰CIBG当局签发体外诊断试剂注册许可；检测方法收录于《中国泌尿外科和男科疾病诊断治疗指南（2022年版）》；完成全球首个尿路上皮癌前瞻性、多中心真实世界注册临床研究；数据发表于专业医学期刊《Clin Epigenetics》和《J Clin Invest》。

- **关于综述作者**

Manel Esteller博士是Josep Carreras 白血病研究所 (IJC) 的所长，贝尔维特生物医学研究所（IDIBELL）癌症表观遗传学和生物学项目（PEBC）主任，癌症表观遗传学组组长，巴塞罗那大学医学院遗传学主席，加泰罗尼亚研究与高级研究所 (ICREA)教授。Esteller一生致力于研究DNA甲基化在癌症中的作用，并编撰了全球通用的甲基化教科书“DNA Methlyation: Approaches, Methods and Applications”。

![](https://www.anchordx.com/Public/ueditor/upload/image/20230209/1675930371221967.png)

## Highlights

- •
Current cancer screening protocols systematically underserve low-income and minority populations.

- •
PRS, AI, MCED tests and life-course models risk reproducing existing inequities if poorly implemented.

- •
Ancestral bias in genomic and imaging datasets limits technology performance in diverse populations.

- •
NHS-Galleri trial shows MCED promise but highlights health system readiness as critical barrier.

- •
Equitable screening requires diverse data, public-system integration, and follow-up capacity.

## Abstract

Cancer screening programmes have substantially reduced cancer mortality in high-income settings, yet their benefits remain unequally distributed. Current protocols are largely based on trials conducted in predominantly white, middle-income populations, leaving significant gaps for minority, low-income, and high-risk groups. Four emerging technologies—polygenic risk scores (PRS), artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted imaging, multi-cancer early detection (MCED) tests, and life-course risk models—offer the possibility of moving beyond these limitations toward more individualised, risk-based screening. However, each technology also carries the risk of reproducing or amplifying existing inequities if the conditions under which it is developed and implemented are not carefully considered. PRS models are constrained by ancestral bias in genomic datasets; AI systems have been trained predominantly on data from high-income, low-diversity populations; MCED tests remain costly and largely inaccessible outside private healthcare; and life-course models depend on integrated longitudinal data infrastructures unavailable in most low- and middle-income settings. Evidence from the NHS-Galleri trial illustrates both the promise and complexity of translating novel screening technology into population-level benefit. This review argues that achieving equitable impact will require three interconnected changes: greater diversity in training data, earlier integration of new technologies into publicly funded health systems, and parallel investment in diagnostic and follow-up capacity. Without deliberate action across these dimensions, advances in cancer screening risk benefiting those already well served while leaving the most vulnerable populations further behind.

## Introduction

Cancer remains one of the leading causes of death worldwide. In 2022 alone, around 19.3 million new cases were diagnosed, and close to 10 million people lost their lives to the disease (Bray et al., 2024). Although early detection and treatment have improved survival rates in high-income countries, these improvements have not been experienced equally across the globe. There are still clear regional differences: for example, treatable cancer deaths account for only 7.6% of expected deaths in North America and 11.0% in Northern Europe, while the same figure rises to over 28–32% in sub-Saharan Africa (Langselius et al., 2026). These differences are not random. They reflect, at least in part, how screening systems are designed and implemented, as well as broader inequalities in access to timely diagnosis and effective care.

Organised cancer screening programmes are among the most effective tools available in modern oncology. Large randomised controlled trials (RCTs) have played a key role in shaping screening protocols for cancers such as breast, colorectal, cervical, and lung cancer in high-income settings. However, the populations included in these landmark trials—such as the National Lung Screening Trial (NLST), the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial (PLCO), and the Canadian National Breast Screening Study (NBSS)—were mostly middle-income individuals of European ancestry with stable access to healthcare (NLST Research Team, 2011, Gohagan et al., 2000, Miller et al., 2014). As Rothwell (2005) pointed out in a widely cited analysis, one of the main criticisms of RCTs is their limited external validity. In other words, these studies tend to work well for a “standard patient,” but real-world populations are far more diverse—and cancer does not limit itself to standard patients.

This mismatch has real consequences. There is increasing evidence that the stage at which cancer is diagnosed varies considerably with income level, ethnicity, and geographic location. People from low-income and minority backgrounds are more likely to be diagnosed at later stages (Loree et al., 2019). **Abstract:** Liquid biopsy has emerged as a revolutionary, minimally invasive approach in precision oncology, enabling dynamic molecular profiling of tumors through analysis of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor cells (CTCs), exosomes, and other biomarkers in body fluids. Focusing specifically on recent advances from 2023 to 2026, this review provides a laboratory-centered critical synthesis addressing the core operational questions for clinical implementation: which liquid biopsy platform should be selected for specific analytes and clinical intents, under what pre-analytical and analytical constraints, and with what quality-control and clinical utility standards. Key technological developments include highly sensitive next-generation sequencing (NGS) with unique molecular identifiers (UMIs), digital droplet PCR (ddPCR), multi-omics integration, and artificial intelligence-assisted interpretation, which have improved detection sensitivity to ultra-low variant allele frequencies. Major clinical applications encompass multi-cancer early detection (MCED), companion diagnostics, real-time treatment monitoring, minimal residual disease (MRD) assessment, and resistance mutation tracking. These tools often provide earlier insights than imaging and better capture tumor heterogeneity. Compared with tissue biopsy, liquid biopsy offers advantages in repeatability, speed, and systemic representation, though challenges remain in sensitivity for early-stage disease, standardization, cost-effectiveness, and implementation in grassroots hospitals. Future directions emphasize multi-omics, AI, and automated workflows to enhance its role across the cancer continuum. This review highlights practical recommendations for clinical laboratories, positioning liquid biopsy as a cornerstone of personalized, proactive oncology care.

**Keywords:** liquid biopsy, ctDNA, precision oncology, companion diagnostics, MRD, multi-omics, clinical laboratory

## Introduction

Cancer remains one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide, with nearly 20 million new cases and approximately 9.7 million deaths reported in 2022. Liquid biopsy refers to the detection and analysis of circulating tumor components, including circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor cells (CTCs), exosomes (extracellular vesicles), circulating RNA (cfRNA), and other analytes such as tumor-educated platelets or proteins.[4](https://www.dovepress.com/advances-in-liquid-biopsy-for-precision-oncology-applications-challeng-peer-reviewed-fulltext-article-OTT#cit0004) Unlike tissue biopsies, which provide a static snapshot of a single tumor site, liquid biopsy offers real-time insights into the molecular landscape of the entire tumor burden, including primary tumors, metastases, and minimal residual disease (MRD).[5](https://www.dovepress.com/advances-in-liquid-biopsy-for-precision-oncology-applications-challeng-peer-reviewed-fulltext-article-OTT#cit0005) This capability is particularly valuable for monitoring clonal evolution, detecting treatment resistance, and enabling personalized therapeutic strategies.[6](https://www.dovepress.com/advances-in-liquid-biopsy-for-precision-oncology-applications-challeng-peer-reviewed-fulltext-article-OTT#cit0006)

The Committee voted seven to two with one abstention that the benefits of Galleri outweigh its risks, unanimously in support of Galleri’s safety, and six to four in support of Galleri’s effectiveness. “The Galleri test was developed to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of our national cancer screening program by adding multi-cancer early detection to recommended screening—helping find more cancers safely, when they may be easier and less costly to treat, and it still may be possible for a patient to receive treatment with curative intent,” said Josh Ofman, MD, MSHS, CEO at GRAIL. “Today’s vote reinforces the strength of Galleri’s clinical evidence. We believe the panel’s recommendations reaffirm a high evidence bar that GRAIL has set for a multi-cancer early detection test. In clinical studies, Galleri has detected approximately four to seven times more cancers compared to standard of care alone, with most Galleri-detected cancers found at earlier stages, when treatment with curative intent may be possible, while maintaining a low false-positive rate and high Cancer Signal Origin prediction accuracy. The FDA designated Galleri as a Breakthrough Device in 2018. GRAIL submitted its PMA application for Galleri to the FDA on Jan. 29, 2026.  The FDA convenes advisory committees to obtain independent expert advice. The agency is not bound by the Committee’s recommendations, though it takes them into consideration when making final regulatory decisions. Grail市值腰斩，多癌早筛赛道迎生死考验

2026-02-27 09:49
[查看原文](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/W4zReYjQKI4h8-ZPGRZkrQ)

收藏

![](https://pharmcube-bydrug.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/info/message_cn_img/3b9e06c4172e329e3e864cc3c78d0eb8.png)

![](https://pharmcube-bydrug.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/info/message_cn_img/bf20b4538e3f64364f9a1fbc8a9661eb.png)

当资本市场的狂热褪去，曾经被捧为“癌症早筛圣杯”的Grail，终究没能扛住临床数据的考验。近期，这家全球多癌早筛领域的头部企业遭遇资本市场重创，股价上演“断崖式”下跌，市值一夜蒸发近半，不仅自身陷入发展困境，更引发了市场对整个多癌种早筛赛道的广泛担忧，曾经被资本寄予厚望的千亿赛道，正迎来前所未有的生死考验。而Max Gelman发表在STAT News的一篇文章，更揭开了Grail核心产品Galleri推广背后的深层矛盾——医生向30岁低风险人群推销这款血检，折射出商业营销、行业推广与临床证据不足的尖锐对立，为Grail的困境再添一层阴霾。

这场市值雪崩的导火索，是Grail核心产品Galleri的最新临床试验数据不及预期。2月19日，Grail同步公布了临床试验结果与2025年财务业绩，一则重磅消息击碎了市场的高预期：这款号称可在癌症无症状前筛查50多种癌症的血液检测产品，在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）主导的三年期研究中，未能显著减少诊断时晚期癌症（III–IV期）的数量。消息一出，Grail股价应声暴跌，跌破100美元关口，刷新历史最大跌幅纪录。尽管2月24日出现17.01%的小幅反弹，但收盘价仍徘徊在50.35美元/股，较2月19日的101.53美元近乎腰斩，市值蒸发规模令人咋舌；截至2月26日，股价小幅回升至58.1美元，但较此前高点仍大幅缩水，颓势难改。而STAT News的文章则指出，这一关键试验的中期结果早已引发对产品临床价值的质疑，却并未阻止其过度推广的步伐。

![](https://pharmcube-bydrug.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/info/message_cn_img/51cfa946c1c52465258e01f0875ae4f4.png)

作为多癌早筛赛道的“明星企业”，Grail的起点堪称“顶配”。成立于2016年的Grail，由基因测序巨头Illumina孵化，前世界首富、微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨亦参与投资，凭借“一次抽血筛50多种癌症”的颠覆性卖点，自诞生以来就备受资本追捧。其核心产品Galleri作为主动式早筛工具，无需针对性检测，可覆盖卵巢癌、胰腺癌等常规筛查难以触及的高危癌种，初衷是通过早期预警癌症，为患者争取宝贵的诊疗时间，这也让它一度成为全球癌症早筛领域的希望。Grail官网曾宣传，该产品对12种占美国癌症死亡人数三分之二的高危癌种灵敏度可达76.3%，假阳性率仅0.4%，看似表现优异，但这些数据背后，隐藏着被营销话术掩盖的诸多局限。

此次引发市场震荡的NHS试验，本是Grail验证产品临床有效性的关键一步。该试验为期三年，纳入逾14.2万名50至77岁受试者，是全球最大的多癌早筛试验之一，早在2020年，英国NHS就计划推进其大规模测试，足见对该产品的期待，其试验结果本应成为Galleri全球推广和监管审批的重要支撑。然而，核心数据的不及预期，让这一切都蒙上了阴影。值得注意的是，肿瘤标志物检测本身就存在局限性，无法作为确诊癌症的唯一依据，且存在假阴性、个体差异等问题，Galleri作为基于血液检测的多癌早筛产品，或许也未能突破这一技术瓶颈。更值得警惕的是，正如STAT News文章所揭示的，这款产品的推广早已偏离了其官方定位，陷入了“超前推广”的怪圈——美国FDA尚未正式批准Galleri用于普通人群筛查，仅授予其“突破性器械”认定，但Grail早已凭借LDT路径大规模商业化，甚至将目标人群延伸至低风险群体。

STAT News的文章中，作者Max Gelman分享了自身经历：年近30岁、无明显癌症风险的他，其家庭医生却主动推荐了Galleri血检，单次价格约950美元，且绝大多数医保不覆盖，这一现象背后，是多重因素共同推动的医生推销行为。其一，商业与营销驱动是核心动力：Grail投入巨额资金用于产品推广，通过药企代表、学术会议、医生教育项目等多种渠道触达临床医生；部分诊所与检测公司存在合作分成，或将其作为“高端体检”的增值服务，以此提升营收；而“一次抽血筛50+癌”的营销话术，极具吸引力，轻易抓住了大众对癌症的恐惧心理。其二，临床认知偏差与“预防性医疗”焦虑加剧了推广乱象：部分医生受Grail宣传影响，片面认为其能填补胰腺癌、卵巢癌等无常规筛查癌种的早筛空白；随着患者对“早癌筛查”的需求上升，医生为满足患者期待、避免漏诊风险，也倾向于推荐这类“更全面”的检测；更有甚者，未充分评估产品的适用人群与性能局限，盲目推广。其三，行业与监管的脱节为“超前推广”提供了空间，FDA的审批滞后与Grail的商业化提速形成鲜明对比，进一步放大了产品推广与临床证据之间的矛盾。

这场过度推广的背后，是Galleri检测诸多未被正视的“存疑”之处，这也是STAT News文章的核心批判点。首先，性能数据存在明显局限性：Galleri对I期癌症的灵敏度仅约17%–27%，意味着超70%的早期癌症会被漏检；而对IV期癌症的灵敏度却超过90%，与其说是“早筛工具”，更像是“晚期癌检测”，与Grail宣传的“早期预警”定位严重不符。尽管Grail宣称产品阳性预测值（PPV）约为62%，但在低风险人群中实际PPV更低，假阳性结果会引发患者不必要的活检、CT检查，不仅带来经济负担，更会造成严重的心理焦虑。更关键的是适用人群错配：官方明确推荐50岁以上高风险成人使用，作为常规筛查的补充，但该产品却被大量推广给30–40岁的低风险者，性价比极低，完全违背了循证医疗的原则。

其次，产品的临床获益尚未得到证实。NHS-Galleri这一关键试验未达到“降低晚期癌比例”的主要终点，至今没有证据证明Galleri能延长患者生存期，这与Grail在试验声明中强调的“12种高死亡率癌症IV期诊断率下降”形成鲜明反差，被专家批评为“给糟糕的结果涂脂抹粉”。同时，该产品还存在过度诊断风险：检测出的微小、惰性病灶，可能本身不会对健康造成威胁，却可能被过度治疗，给患者带来医源性伤害。此外，经济与伦理问题也备受诟病：950美元的自费价格的，医保不予覆盖，大幅加重了患者的经济负担；而Grail将巨额资金投入营销而非临床研究，被业内批评为“公共风险、私人获利”，违背了医疗产品的公益属性。

面对数据争议与产品质疑，Grail总裁Josh Ofman公开进行了辩护。他表示，尽管NHS试验未达到主要目标，但重复检测后，12种高死亡率癌症的4期诊断率明显下降，具有重要临床价值。同时，Grail宣布将试验随访期延长6至12个月，认为数据成熟后或能呈现更显著效果，并表示将深入分析数据，扩大销售和医疗团队推进产品推广，不认为此次数据折戟是行业挫折。Grail在试验声明中还提到，Galleri联合常规筛查可使癌症检测率提升四倍，且能增加早期癌症检出数量，但这些表述被专家质疑“缺乏统计学支撑，无法被有效解读”。但资本市场并未买账，这背后是此前过高的市场预期与现实的巨大落差。回顾Grail的股价表现，它曾是资本市场的“黑马”，2025年股价从不足20美元飙升至超100美元，过去六个月累计涨幅超200%，背后是市场对多癌早筛赛道的无限憧憬，以及对Galleri产品商业化的极高期待。此次暴跌不仅抹去了所有近期涨幅，更让市场开始重新审视多癌早筛技术的临床价值与商业化可行性——毕竟，一款无法有效降低晚期癌症诊断率、且存在诸多局限的早筛产品，难以支撑起资本市场的狂热追捧。

财务数据的表现，进一步凸显了Grail的发展困境。2025年财报显示，Grail全年收入为1.472亿美元，同比增长17%，其中美国市场Galleri产品营收同比增长26%，至1.368亿美元；但与此同时，公司净亏损仍高达4.084亿美元。从其季度财务数据来看，2025年各季度均处于亏损状态，持续的亏损让公司现金流面临压力，也让资本市场对其盈利能力产生质疑。而STAT News文章揭示的过度推广现象，或许能解释营收增长的部分原因，但这种依赖营销驱动、偏离临床需求的增长，显然难以持续——毕竟，随着产品局限被曝光、专家质疑声四起，低风险人群的购买意愿终将下降，而高风险人群的信任度也会受到冲击。

更关键的是，此次数据折戟与推广乱象，还牵动着Grail的监管与商业化进程。今年1月，Grail已向美国FDA提交Galleri的上市前批准（PMA）申请，这是其实现规范化商业化的关键一步，若能获批，将有望打开医保覆盖大门，破解当前商业化推广的核心瓶颈。值得注意的是，此次提交的申请材料仅包含美国PATHFINDER 2研究及NHS试验第一年数据，并未纳入此次未达终点的最新数据。据悉，PATHFINDER 2研究曾发表于《柳叶刀》，显示Galleri在癌症信号组织来源预测、缩短诊断时间等方面表现优异，真实世界研究也显示其癌症起源预测准确率可达87%，但这些优势无法掩盖其在降低晚期癌症诊断率上的短板。此次NHS最新数据以及STAT News曝光的推广乱象，是否会影响FDA审批，目前尚不明确。巧合的是，FDA近期宣布将新药审批从需要两项成功临床试验改为只需一项，这一政策调整或许能为Grail的审批带来一丝转机，但核心仍取决于产品的临床价值。

目前，Galleri尚未获得美国FDA正式批准，仅能依托LDT（实验室自建检测）合规路径，凭医师处方在美国使用，定价949美元/次（与STAT News报道的950美元基本一致）。Grail官网坦言，绝大多数医保不覆盖该检测，患者自费成为其商业化推广的主要门槛——这一困境并非Grail独有，而是整个多癌早筛赛道的共性问题。此前，“癌症早筛第一股”诺辉健康因财务造假黯然退市，其背后也暴露了行业支付方缺位、C端推广难度大的痛点，当前早筛产品多依赖消费者自费，市场放量缓慢，企业普遍面临巨大的资本压力与盈利难题。而Grail的过度推广，不仅未能破解这一难题，反而因偏离临床需求，加剧了行业信任危机。

业内人士分析，Grail的困境，本质上折射出多癌早筛赛道“高预期与高风险并存”的现状。作为行业标杆，Grail的每一步动向都牵动着整个赛道的神经，其核心产品数据不及预期、推广乱象曝光，不仅影响自身的发展前景，更可能引发市场对整个多癌早筛行业的重新审视，促使资本和行业回归理性，聚焦多癌早筛的临床价值与商业化瓶颈。多位权威专家早已明确反对Galleri的常规临床推广，其中H. Gilbert Welch、Eric Topol等专家直言：“医生不应使用或推荐这类检测，它们只会增加费用、引发更多检查与焦虑，还可能导致过度诊断与治疗”。Eric Topol还曾批评Galleri在健康高龄人群中检测早期癌症的效率低下，假阴性比例偏高，违背了循证医疗的原则。Max Gelman在文章中也呼吁：癌症筛查应基于循证、按年龄与风险分层，而非被商业营销驱动的“全能血检”绑架。

当前，全球癌症早筛市场仍由单癌筛查占据主导地位，这类产品凭借明确的临床证据支撑、清晰的监管审批路径和确定的临床应用结局，成为目前行业发展的核心主线，而多癌早筛则仍需突破技术、临床、商业化等多重难关。Grail的案例警示行业，多癌早筛的核心价值在于“早期预警、降低死亡率”，若脱离这一核心，过度依赖营销、盲目扩大适用人群，最终只会被市场和临床抛弃。

对于Grail而言，未来几个月将是决定其生死的关键考验期。它能否翻身，取决于两个核心因素：一是延长随访期后，能否拿出更有说服力的临床数据，重新证明产品的临床价值；二是FDA的审批进展，能否顺利获批，打开医保覆盖的大门，实现商业化的突破。若能达成这两个目标，Grail有望重获市场信任，重新引领多癌早筛赛道的发展；反之，其商业化前景将彻底蒙上阴影，甚至可能被市场淘汰。

Grail的折戟，给整个多癌早筛赛道敲响了警钟。对于整个行业而言，Grail的困境或许不是终点，而是行业回归理性、聚焦核心价值的起点——只有真正实现技术突破，拿出过硬的临床数据，破解支付难题，坚守循证医疗原则，多癌早筛才能真正从“概念”走向“现实”，真正成为守护人类健康的“防癌利器”。而Grail能否挺过这场危机，重新扛起多癌早筛的大旗，值得整个行业持续关注。

# Exact Sciences acquires liquid-biopsy start-up Thrive in $2.15 billion deal

by

[Ryan Cross](https://cen.acs.org/staffDirectory/DynamicList.html?authorName=Ryan+Cross)

October 31, 20201
min read

A version of this story appeared in

[Volume 98, Issue\\
42](https://cen.acs.org/magazine/98/09842.html)

- Share
- SaveSave

## Business Briefs

The latest short chemistry business news items from C&EN.

[Read More](https://cen.acs.org/explore/news/briefs/business-briefs.html)

Exact Sciences, a diagnostics firm that sells the colon cancer test Cologuard, will acquire the [liquid-biopsy](https://cen.acs.org/analytical-chemistry/diagnostics/Firms-aim-develop-liquid-biopsies/97/i47 "Firms aim to develop liquid biopsies for early cancer detection") start-up Thrive Earlier Detection for $1.7 billion, plus $450 million in potential milestone payments. Thrive launched in 2019 based on the work of three oncologists at Johns Hopkins University who had developed [a blood test, CancerSEEK,](https://cen.acs.org/business/start-ups/Liquid-biopsy-startThrive-launches-110/97/i22) that analyzes DNA and proteins in seemingly healthy people to spot early signs of cancer. The buyout comes just 1 month after the DNA sequencing giant [Illumina announced](https://cen.acs.org/analytical-chemistry/diagnostics/Illumina-pay-8-billion-bring/98/i37) that it would buy the liquid-biopsy start-up [Grail](https://cen.acs.org/business/start-ups/Grail-raises-funds-advance-blood/96/i22 "Grail raises more funds to advance a blood-based cancer test") for $8 billion.

# NCI Selects Two Assays for the Vanguard Study on Multi-Cancer Detection Tests

Date PostedTuesday, January 7, 2025

The National Cancer Institute (NCI) has selected two assays to be included in the Vanguard Study on multi-cancer detection (MCD) tests which will be conducted by the [Cancer Screening Research Network (CSRN)](https://prevention.cancer.gov/research-areas/networks-consortia-programs/csrn "Cancer Screening Research Network (CSRN)"). The two assays selected, in alphabetical order, are the Avantect® Multi-Cancer Detection Test by ClearNote Health, headquartered in San Diego, California, and Shield™ Multi-Cancer Detection Test by Guardant Health, headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

In February 2024, [NCI launched the CSRN](https://www.cancer.gov/news-events/press-releases/2024/cancer-screening-research-network-launches), a clinical trials network created to evaluate emerging technologies for cancer screening with the ultimate goal of reducing cancer-related deaths. In 2025, the CSRN will launch the Vanguard Study to address the feasibility of using MCD tests in future randomized controlled trials. The Vanguard Study will enroll up to 24,000 people to inform the design of a much larger randomized controlled trial. This larger trial will evaluate whether the benefits of using MCD tests to screen for cancer outweigh the harms, and whether they can detect cancer early in a way that reduces deaths.

NCI selected the Avantect® Multi-Cancer Detection Test by ClearNote Health and the Shield™ Multi-Cancer Detection Test by Guardant Health based on a formal evaluation process. The process started with a request for information ( [NOT-CA-22-033](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/notice-files/NOT-CA-22-033.html)) released in January 2022 to assess both the availability and readiness of MCD tests for inclusion in the Vanguard Study and the willingness of MCD assay developers to participate.

In May of 2023, NCI hosted a public workshop to engage MCD assay developers ( [NOT-CA-23-055](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/notice-files/NOT-CA-23-055.html)) in the process. At this public workshop, NCI invited companies to apply to have their assays considered for inclusion in the Vanguard Study. Assay developers needed to provide a formal application. Selected assays were identified for a performance verification process. NCI sent those companies a blinded reference set to test their assays on specimens from the [Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology](https://www.cancer.gov/research/participate/clinical-trials-search/v?id=NCT05334069&r=1) and companies sent their results back to NCI for analysis. Results from the NCI verification study and details on the assay selection process will be published in 2025.

Read the company press releases:

- [ClearNote Health’s Avantect® Multi-Cancer Detection Test Selected as One of Two Noninvasive Blood-Based Technologies for National Cancer Institute’s Vanguard Study](https://www.clearnotehealth.com/clearnote-healths-avantect-multi-cancer-detection-test-selected-as-one-of-two-noninvasive-blood-based-technologies-for-national-cancer-institutes-vanguard-study/)
- [Guardant Health Shield platform selected for inclusion in the National Cancer Institute’s Vanguard Study to evaluate emerging technologies for multi-cancer detection](https://investors.guardanthealth.com/press-releases/press-releases/2025/Guardant-Health-Shield-Platform-Selected-for-Inclusion-in-National-Cancer-Institutes-Vanguard-Study-to-Evaluate-Emerging-Technologies-for-Multi-Cancer-Detection/default.aspx)

Learn more about the CSRN:

- [Cancer Screening Research Network (CSRN) \| Division of Cancer Prevention](https://prevention.cancer.gov/node/1308)
- [Cancer Screening Research Network \| Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center](https://www.fredhutch.org/en/research/institutes-networks-ircs/cancer-screening-research-network.html)

[Accessibility Statement](https://www.cision.com/about/accessibility/) [Skip Navigation](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/freenome-reports-top-line-readout-of-updated-simplescreen-crc-colorectal-cancer-screening-blood-test-met-all-primary-and-secondary-endpoints-302821493.html#main) _– Updated test version achieved significant performance improvement in detecting advanced precancerous lesions, including those with high-grade dysplasia –_ _– Modeling projects the improvements would translate to 1,582 additional life-years gained (7.7%), 426 fewer CRC cases (9.5%) and 143 fewer CRC deaths (9.5%) per 100,000 individuals screened, compared to the first-generation test –_ BRISBANE, Calif., July 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Freenome, an early cancer detection company developing blood-based screening tests, today announced favorable results from its pivotal clinical validation study assessing the performance of assay and algorithm improvements for its updated version of the SimpleScreen™ CRC blood-based colorectal cancer (CRC) screening test. The study successfully met its primary and secondary endpoints. The updated test showed 18.2% sensitivity for detecting advanced precancerous lesions (APLs), 41.9% sensitivity for APLs with high-grade dysplasia (HGD), and 80.4% sensitivity for detecting CRC, including 52% of Stage I cases (Stage I (T1) 39.9% and Stage I (T2) 81.2%), 100% of Stage II, 97.3% of Stage III and 100% of Stage IV. The results were adjusted to the age and sex distribution of the U.S. Census to better reflect the intended use population, and specificity for no findings on colonoscopy was 90%. CRC remains the second-leading cause of cancer-related death in the United States, yet more than 50 million eligible adults are not up to date on recommended screening. Blood-based screening tests have the potential to reach people who might otherwise remain unscreened. The clinical validation of the updated SimpleScreen CRC test includes blinded, previously unevaluated samples from participants who enrolled in PREEMPT CRC1 \-\- a prospective, registrational study -- as well as previously tested samples. Conducted at more than 200 sites, the PREEMPT CRC study enrolled 48,995 asymptomatic, average-risk adults between the ages of 45 and 85 scheduled to undergo a screening colonoscopy. The analysis included more than 85 individuals with CRC, 1,500 with APLs, and 150 with APLs with HGD. | | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Endpoint** | **Updated SimpleScreen CRC**

The sensitivity results for APL and APL with HGD demonstrated in this study are the highest reported to date for any non-invasive screening blood test in a prospective registrational pivotal clinical study. "The sensitivity for APL and APL with HGD for the updated SimpleScreen CRC test is a marked improvement and gets us closer to matching the performance of certain stool-based CRC screening tests, with potentially higher adherence," noted Aasma Shaukat, M.D., M.P.H., professor of medicine at NYU Grossman School of Medicine and a co-lead principal investigator on the PREEMPT CRC study. With the improved detection of APLs and HGD, our published model3 suggests that the updated test would result in 7.7% more life-years gained, 9.5% more cases of cancer prevented, and 9.5% more cancer deaths prevented, compared to the first-generation CRC test version.4 "This study marks a major milestone in our mission to advance blood-based colorectal cancer screening," said Aaron Elliott, Ph.D., CEO of Freenome. "The significant improvement in detecting precancerous lesions demonstrates the critical role our SimpleScreen CRC platform can play in early detection and prevention of colon cancer. With millions of eligible Americans still not getting screened, expanding access to accurate, non-invasive screening options that patients are more likely to complete has never been more important." Freenome submitted its Premarket Approval (PMA) application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in August 2025 for the first-generation version of its SimpleScreen CRC test. The FDA is expected to complete its review in mid 2026. Freenome intends to submit a supplemental PMA to the FDA for the next-generation SimpleScreen CRC test. In August 2025, Freenome and Abbott entered into a commercial collaboration agreement to bring SimpleScreen CRC to market. Upon FDA approval, SimpleScreen CRC will be exclusively commercialized and made available by Abbott. Freenome will be offering a multi-cancer product consisting of SimpleScreen CRC in combination with its SimpleScreen Lung laboratory-developed test solely to patients who are eligible for both screenings. The commercial collaboration agreement included a milestone payment tied to the outcome of this study. That intended milestone payment will be set at $70 million, pending FDA approval of the next-generation test and the successful technology transfer of the product to Abbott. Freenome and Abbott are collaborating on a multi-year R&D program focused on improving assay performance. "These results strengthen our confidence in the role blood-based colorectal cancer screening can play in expanding screening," said Jake Orville, senior vice president of Abbott's cancer diagnostics business. "Combined with Abbott's preferred, guideline-supported screening option, we're uniquely positioned to offer healthcare providers and patients a differentiated colorectal cancer screening portfolio built on innovation, performance and choice—with one goal in mind: helping more people get screened." While the foundational SimpleScreen CRC test will provide a robust, clinically validated screening option for patients, Freenome continues to advance its next-generation pipeline of single- and multi-cancer tests. Through its pioneering Personalized Cancer Detection approach to screening, Freenome will be matching blood-based screening tests to the cancers most relevant to individuals based on their health profile, while leveraging its multiomics platform to optimize test performance for additional validated indications. **About Freenome** Freenome is an early cancer detection company developing blood-based tests to detect cancer when it is most treatable. The company recognizes that no single technology can identify every cancer due to the disease's inherent heterogeneity. Freenome's approach combines a multiomics platform that analyzes multiple signals in the blood with artificial intelligence and machine learning to tune into cancer's subtlest clues, even at the earliest stages of the disease. **References** 1\. # FDA Approves SimpleScreen CRC Blood-Based Screening Test for Colorectal Cancer

[By The ASCO Post Staff](https://www.ascopost.com/search-results/?q=The+ASCO+Post)

Posted: 7/29/2026 9:40:00 AM

Last Updated: 7/29/2026 9:00:53 AM

Advertisement

[![Get Permission](https://ascopost.com/media/14017133/get-permission-btn-big.png)](https://marketplace.copyright.com/rs-ui-web/mp/details/journal/161389313)

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved [SimpleScreen CRC](https://www.simplescreentest.com/), a new blood-based screening option for colorectal cancer in adults aged 45 years and older who are at average risk for the disease. The test is produced by Freenome; Abbott will exclusively commercialize the test in the United States in fall 2026.

Colorectal cancer is the second-leading cause of cancer-related death in the United States, but it is highly preventable and treatable when detected early through screening. [Up to 60 million Americans remain overdue for recommended screening](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2816965), underscoring the need for additional convenient screening approaches that can help reach more people.

SimpleScreen CRC detects signals associated with colorectal cancer from cell-free DNA (cfDNA) in the blood. The FDA approval reflects years of clinical research; artificial intelligence/machine learning–driven technology development; and extensive collaboration with investigators, health-care providers, and partners.

“The most effective screening test is the one a person will actually complete,” said **Aasma Shaukat, MD, MPH**, Professor of Medicine at NYU Grossman School of Medicine and a co-lead principal investigator on the PREEMPT CRC study. “Many people who should be screened for colorectal cancer simply aren’t. A blood-based test provides another way to reach unscreened patients, and bringing more people into the screening fold leads to earlier detection and better outcomes.”

**PREEMPT CRC**

[SimpleScreen CRC was evaluated in PREEMPT CRC](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2834891), the largest prospective clinical validation study ever conducted for a blood-based colorectal cancer screening test. Conducted at over 200 sites, PREEMPT CRC enrolled more than 48,000 asymptomatic, average-risk adults between the ages of 45 and 85 years who were scheduled for a screening colonoscopy. In a prespecified analysis adjusted to match the U.S. Census, SimpleScreen CRC detected colorectal cancer with 81.1% sensitivity and advanced precancerous lesions with 13.7% sensitivity, including 30.7% for advanced precancerous lesions with high-grade dysplasia. The test showed 90.4% specificity for advanced colorectal neoplasia. In practical terms, the test correctly detected about 8 in 10 colorectal cancers while correctly producing negative results for 9 of 10 people without colorectal cancer or advanced precancerous lesions.

“The fact is that 90% of colorectal cancer deaths are preventable, yet the disease will still claim more than 55,000 lives in the U.S. this year alone,” added **Anjee Davis, MPAA**, Chief Executive Officer of Fight Colorectal Cancer. “Regular screening is the key to reversing that trend, and new, minimally invasive screening options that help more people get screened are a critical part of that process. Colorectal cancer is increasingly affecting younger adults, and a screening test that fits into a routine visit, accompanied by prompt follow-up in response to an abnormal result, can play an important role in driving earlier treatment and prevention.”

With FDA approval, SimpleScreen CRC meets the coverage criteria for Medicare and is expected to be incorporated into the American Cancer Society guidelines.

The test is indicated for adults aged 45 years and older who are at average risk for colorectal cancer and referred by a health-care provider for colorectal cancer screening. A positive result indicates a signal was detected that may suggest the presence of colorectal cancer or advanced precancerous lesions and should be followed by colonoscopy. SimpleScreen CRC is not a replacement for diagnostic colonoscopy or for surveillance colonoscopy in high-risk individuals.

_The content in this post has not been reviewed by the American Society of Clinical Oncology, Inc. (ASCO®) and does not necessarily reflect the ideas and opinions of ASCO®._

- _City of Hope®to launch an investigator-led study funded by a grant from the American Cancer Society to improve screening among     patients, including a Federally Qualified Health Center_
- _FirstLook Lung is the first liquid biopsy test available in the U.S. that has high sensitivity for early lung cancer detection_

**CONTACT**

City of Hope:

Letisia Marquez

626-476-7593

[lemarquez@coh.org](https://www.cityofhope.org/about-city-of-hope/newsroom/city-of-hope-and-delfi-diagnostics-announce-collaboration-to-improve-lung-cancer-screening-rates)

DELFI Diagnostics:

Jen Bruursema

202-316-4553

[jen.bruursema@delfidiagnostics.com](https://www.cityofhope.org/about-city-of-hope/newsroom/city-of-hope-and-delfi-diagnostics-announce-collaboration-to-improve-lung-cancer-screening-rates)

**LOS ANGELES, PALO ALTO, Calif., and BALTIMORE** — City of Hope, one of the largest cancer research and treatment organizations in the United States, and DELFI Diagnostics Inc., a developer of accessible blood-based tests that deliver a new way to enhance cancer detection, today announced a collaboration to utilize DELFI’s FirstLook Lung, a blood-based lung cancer screening test, in a City of Hope [clinical study](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05384769) to help improve screening rates in underserved communities in Los Angeles County. The test will be offered free of charge to eligible trial participants. Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer deaths domestically and globally, yet only 6% of eligible individuals in the U.S. get screened and, in California, this statistic drops to 0.7%.

Funded by a Discovery Boost grant from the American Cancer Society, awarded to [Dan Raz](https://www.cityofhope.org/dan-raz), M.D., M.A.S., co-director of City of Hope’s Lung Cancer and Thoracic Oncology Program and the trial’s principal investigator, the study that will evaluate use of the FirstLook Lung test to improve lung cancer screening rates in disadvantaged communities in the Los Angeles area. DELFI will make its liquid biopsy screening test, which will be submitted to the Food and Drug Administration for approval, available at various study locations, including [City of Hope \| Antelope Valley](https://www.cityofhope.org/locations/antelope-valley), a City of Hope mobile screening unit in the near future, and ParkTree Community Health Center, a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC). [Nearly 1 in 10](https://bphc.hrsa.gov/about-health-center-program/impact-health-center-program) Americans rely on FQHCs for their care.

“Our City of Hope team is grateful to the American Cancer Society for its commitment to addressing cancer screening disparities and for their support of our community-based study that is so desperately needed in these areas,” said Raz, who is also an associate professor in the Division of Thoracic Surgery at City of Hope. “We hope that by offering a high-sensitivity lung cancer blood test, we can catch more lung cancer early. If lung cancer is caught early, there is a higher chance of it being treated effectively.

“We have known for more than a decade that lung cancer screening saves lives. We now want to find practical approaches that will deliver that benefit to all who are eligible,” he added. Prior research has demonstrated that providing more screening options improves overall screening rates, and the study aims to determine if some patients say they prefer a screening blood test as a way of being evaluated.

FirstLook Lung works by evaluating patterns of DNA fragments in the blood that reveal the presence of lung cancer. In an independent validation, FirstLook Lung was shown to have screening population sensitivity of 80%, including detection of the earliest stages of the disease. The test relies on a low-cost approach to DNA analysis, which will enable the company to make it broadly available at an affordable cost. It also produces clinically meaningful results. When the test result is negative (“Not Elevated”), the chance lung cancer will be found by low-dose CT scan is less than 0.2%.

“City of Hope is making a positive impact in reaching communities who are often left behind by the U.S. health care system, aligning with our mission at DELFI,” said Peter B. Bach, M.D., DELFI’s chief medical officer. “We are immensely proud that FirstLook Lung, our high- sensitivity blood test, which we developed and validated specifically for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, will be able to play a part in this potentially practice-changing work.”

The American Cancer Society’s Discovery Boost Grants support high-risk, high-reward exploratory cancer research across the research continuum. Investigators may focus on developing research methodologies, establishing feasibility or leading pilot tests in new and highly innovative areas for investigation.

“Currently there are millions of people in this country who are eligible for lung cancer screening according to the guidelines of the American Cancer Society, but who are not accessing the recommended annual CT scan,” said [Christina Annunziata](https://www.cancer.org/research/acs-researchers/christina-annunziata-bio.html), M.D., Ph.D., senior vice president, extramural discovery science at the American Cancer Society. “We are excited to have funded the early work in this project which will test this alternative screening method that may be more accessible and therefore has the potential to reach more people.”

City of Hope (Booth No. 1605) and DELFI Diagnostics (Booth No. 947) will be exhibiting at the American Association of Cancer Research ( [AACR 2024](https://www.aacr.org/meeting/aacr-annual-meeting-2024/)) Conference in San Diego from April 7 to 10 and are available for interviews about this new collaboration.

证据为ColoSense™ S014补充申请获批(APPR)，与既有事件同为同一项FDA监管批准的补充信息，但新增了关键事实：样本保存液保质期从12个月延长至18个月，且日期(2026-09-08)不同于既有事件(2026-07-29)。

events.title: The Role of Multicancer Early Detection Tests in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Case Series.

facts.case_series: 回顾性纳入2020年1月至2026年3月因Galleri MCED结果阳性提示HNSCC而转诊至耳鼻喉科的3例患者
facts.stage_and_outcome: 3例患者均为无症状、查体基本无异常的早期p16+口咽鳞癌，均成功切除且早期随访无复发
facts.external_detection_rate: 引用Dana-Farber早期经验：14例Galleri阳性患者中78.6%确诊癌症
facts.conclusion: 作者结论：MCED检测可能识别无症状患者的早期HNSCC，耳鼻喉科医生应系统评估MCED阳性转诊患者

fact_revisions.summary: GRAIL Galleri MCED检测在3例无症状患者中成功识别早期p16+口咽鳞癌，均手术切除且无复发。引用Dana-Farber数据称阳性确诊率78.6%。结论支持MCED用于HNSCC早筛。

events.title: Exact Sciences Presents New Findings at ACG 2025 Demonstrating How the Cologuard Test Helps Improve Adherence and Close Screening Gaps

facts.ACG 2025 研究发布: Exact Sciences 在 ACG 2025 年会（2025-10-24至2025-10-29，Phoenix）公布关于 Cologuard 提升筛查依从性的新数据
facts.摘要RWE.88 mt-sDNA依从性: 在2,095名Medicare Advantage未下单mt-sDNA的受试者中，既往mt-sDNA使用者53.4%、既往使用其他粪便检测者38.8%通过护理缺口项目完成筛查
facts.摘要RWE.88 相对完成率: 既往mt-sDNA使用者完成筛查的可能性比既往FIT使用者高74%；接受数字外联者完成检测的可能性高129%
facts.摘要REC.10.3 FIT依从性荟萃分析: 47项研究、405项干预策略中，FIT筛查总体依从性35.7%，有干预时39.4%，无干预时26.1%；FIT阳性后随访肠镜依从性46.6%
facts.摘要MS.44 经济模型比较: 在100万平均风险人群模型中，新一代mt-sDNA筛查人数超过FIT两倍（713,000 vs 318,000），检出晚期癌前病变多5.5倍（21,701 vs 3,328），检出CRC多3.7倍（2,090 vs 440），预防癌症多5.5倍（1,736 vs 266），总成本降低2%（$1,388M vs $1,423M）
facts.Cologuard累积使用量: 自2014年以来，Cologuard已用于超过2,000万次CRC筛查，并列入ACS（2018）与USPSTF（2021）国家筛查指南

result.rationale:
候选证据（cand_502828298c665ecef6eb33f0）描述的是Guardant Health于2026-11-11宣布的“拟发行”（Proposed Offering）可转换票据，而既有事件（evt_c5d2a53d...）描述的是2026-11-12完成的“定价发行”（Prices Offering）。虽然两者属于同一融资交易的不同阶段（从意向到最终定价），但在金融监管和竞争情报语境下，“宣布拟发行”与“最终定价/交割”通常被视为具有不同关键事实的事件。然而，根据任务定义，如果视为同一次发生的不同披露阶段：
1. 若严格区分“公告发布”这一动作：11月11日的公告是首次披露该交易意图，11月12日的公告是披露最终条款。这通常是两个不同的新闻事件（different_event）。
2. 但观察既有事件 `evt_c5d2a53d` 的标题为 "Guardant Health Prices $500 Million Convertible Senior Notes Offering"，其内容包含了最终的定价、转换率等细节。候选证据仅包含“拟发行”、“金额”、“到期日”、“赎回条款”等初步信息，且日期早一天。

重新审视定义：
- `same_event`: 同一份公告...没有新增关键事实。
- `material_update`: 仍是同一次发生，但补充或更正了关键事实。
- `different_event`: 不是同一次发生。同一公司、同一产品的**不同监管里程碑**...都是不同事件。

在资本市场中，“Launch of offering”（启动发行）和“Pricing of offering”（发行定价）是两个独立的重大市场事件（Milestones）。前者告知市场有融资计划，后者确定具体条款。因此，它们应被归类为 `different_event`。既有事件记录的是“定价”，候选记录的是“启动/拟发行”。这是交易生命周期中的两个不同节点。

*自我修正*：等等，让我们仔细看既有事件的ID和内容。既有事件 `evt_c5d2a53d` 发生在 2026-11-12，内容是“Prices...”。候选发生在 2026-11-11，内容是“Announces Proposed...”。
如果系统将整个融资过程视为一个“事件实体”，那么11-11的公告是初始状态，11-12的公告是更新状态。但是，通常“Proposed”和“Priced”被视为两个不同的新闻点。特别是对于投资者而言，11-11的消息导致股价波动（因为稀释预期），11-12的消息确认了具体价格。

再看定义：“同一公司、同一产品的不同监管里程碑...都是不同事件”。融资的“启动”和“完成/定价”类似于监管的“申请”和“批准”，或者是临床试验的“启动”和“结果公布”。它们是不同的里程碑。

因此，判定为 `different_event`。

events.title: Guardant Health Introduces New Epigenomic Applications Providing Deeper Insights for Treatment Selection with Guardant360® Liquid

facts.Guardant Health Introduces New Epigenomi: Guardant Health announced new applications for Guardant360 Liquid designed to help oncologists understand how a patient’s cancer may respond to treatment in the absence of traditional biomarkers.
facts.InfinityAI Platform Integration: The expanded capabilities are powered by InfinityAI, combining genomics and epigenomics to inform therapy selection in breast and lung cancers.
facts.SERD Prediction in Breast Cancer: Two novel epigenomic predictors identify patients that may benefit from selective estrogen receptor degraders (SERDs) in advanced breast cancer.
facts.ICI Monotherapy Prediction in NSCLC: Epigenomic predictors identify patients that may benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) monotherapy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
facts.PD-L1 Negative Identification: Guardant360 Liquid includes epigenomic identification of patients who are PD-L1 negative without requiring a tissue sample.
facts.ALK Fusion Detection Rate: Epigenomic features now identify 20-45% of ALK fusions missed by genomic liquid testing alone.
facts.MTAP Deletion Detection Increase: Epigenomic features identify over 250% more MTAP deletions missed by genomic liquid testing alone.

fact_revisions.summary: Guardant Health于2026年11月11日推出Guardant360 Liquid新表观遗传应用，由InfinityAI驱动。该功能结合基因组与表观遗传学，旨在为乳腺癌和肺癌治疗选择提供深层洞察，识别传统生物标志物缺失时的治疗机会。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和应关注其通过表观遗传学提升ALK融合及MTAP缺失检出率（分别增加20-45%和超250%），以及无组织样本评估PD-L1状态的能力，这可能改变液体活检竞争格局。

rationales.relevance: Guardant360 Liquid 治疗选择扩展，属肿瘤液体活检领域，但非筛查/MCED产品（evidence_ref: cand_32725ffe08aa7e74b1fb6323）
rationales.impact: 治疗选择功能更新，涉及 InfinityAI 甲基化平台能力提升，对筛查竞争格局无直接改变（evidence_ref: cand_32725ffe08aa7e74b1fb6323）
rationales.actionability: 值得持续跟踪 Guardant InfinityAI 甲基化+AI 平台进展，因其底层技术可能与早筛产品（如Shield）共享，但无需立即响应（evidence_ref: cand_32725ffe08aa7e74b1fb6323）

result.reason: 该证据是 Guardant Health 发布的官方新闻稿，宣布为其产品 Guardant360 Liquid 推出新的表观基因组应用。这属于受监测产品的功能更新/发布事件（具体发生的事），且与癌症精准治疗及筛查生态中的液体活检技术密切相关，符合建档标准。

events.title: Freenome Expands Personalized Cancer Detection Portfolio, Launching SimpleScreen™ Lung Test With FDA-Approved SimpleScreen CRC Option

facts.产品发布与组合策略: Freenome宣布推出SimpleScreen Lung，并允许其与FDA批准的SimpleScreen CRC在同一血液样本中联合使用，以覆盖肺癌和结直肠癌筛查。
facts.适用人群定义: SimpleScreen Lung是一种实验室开发测试（LDT），适用于50至80岁、吸烟史≥20包年且目前未参与指南推荐筛查的成年人。
facts.主要临床性能指标: 在独立队列研究（172例肺癌病例和436例对照）中，SimpleScreen Lung显示出85%的灵敏度、50%的特异性和99.8%的阴性预测值（NPV）。
facts.分期特异性灵敏度: 该测试对I期肺癌的灵敏度为82%，II期为75%，III期为91%，IV期为94%。
facts.监管状态对比: SimpleScreen Lung被描述为实验室开发测试（LDT），而同一新闻稿中提到的SimpleScreen CRC已获得FDA批准。

fact_revisions.summary: Freenome于2026年10月20日推出SimpleScreen Lung（LDT），可与FDA批准的CRC测试单次采血联用。针对50-80岁重度吸烟者，独立队列显示灵敏度85%、特异度50%、NPV 99.8%，旨在提升肺癌筛查可及性。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和需关注其“单次采血多癌种”组合策略及LDT模式对监管路径的突破，评估其对现有血液筛查市场格局及临床工作流的影响。

events.title: Freenome Announces Expanded Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning Initiatives Accelerated by NVIDIA, to Advance Personalized Multi-Cancer Detection

facts.collaboration_with_nvidia: Freenome announced an initiative to advance its blood-based early cancer screening program by leveraging NVIDIA deep learning technology and expertise.
facts.fldl_model_training: With NVIDIA accelerated computing, Freenome will scale up training of its proprietary cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragment-level deep learning (FLDL) models.
facts.open_source_methylation_model: Freenome plans to build an open-source methylation foundational model in collaboration with NVIDIA using the BioNeMo Framework.
facts.hco_data_access: Freenome is working with NVIDIA to provide accelerated tooling to healthcare organizations to interrogate de-identified clinical and molecular data for research use.
facts.simple_screen_crc_status: SimpleScreen CRC, Freenome's first blood test for colorectal cancer, is currently under review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
facts.simple_screen_crc_approval_expectation: Approval for SimpleScreen CRC is expected in the second half of 2026.
facts.future_test_launches: The company plans to launch several other blood-based cancer detection tests in 2026, including lung and other indications.

events.title: Decoding coupled epigenetic-fragmentomic signals in circulating cell-free DNA for interpretable cancer diagnosis.

facts.Study Focus: Decoding coupled epigenetic-fragmentomic signals in circulating cell-free DNA for interpretable cancer diagnosis.
facts.Methodology Evaluation: Systematically evaluated preservation of cfDNA fragmentomic features in WGBS and EM-seq relative to conventional WGS.
facts.Biological Insight: Delineated methylation haplotype blocks (MHBs) from plasma cfDNA as biologically interpretable units for organizing multimodal signals.
facts.Model Development: Developed Fragmentomics And Methylation Ensemble (FAME), an interpretable multimodal model integrating MHB-centered methylation and fragmentomic features.
facts.Model Extension: Extended FAME with complementary genome-wide methylation and fragmentomic features to generate FAME-GW.
facts.Comparative Performance: FAME-based models were compared against THEMIS, SPOT-MAS, and DELFI across cross-validation and independent validation.
facts.Performance Outcome: FAME provided a compact and interpretable representation; FAME-GW delivered the strongest overall predictive performance.

fact_revisions.summary: DELFI Diagnostics发表研究，开发FAME及FAME-GW模型，整合cfDNA甲基化与片段组信号。经与SPOT-MAS等对比，FAME-GW展现最强预测性能，提供可解释的癌症诊断方案。
fact_revisions.reason: 其多模态模型在独立验证中性能优于竞品，且强调生物可解释性，对世和现有单模态或黑盒算法构成技术竞争压力。

events.title: DELFI Diagnostics to Showcase Whole-Genome cfDNA Platform Advances in Cancer Detection and Monitoring at AACR 2026 Annual Meeting

facts.DELFI Diagnostics to Showcase Whole-Geno: DELFI Diagnostics announced it will present five poster presentations at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) 2026 Annual Meeting, taking place April 17–22, 2026 in San Diego, CA.
facts.Poster Presentation: Cell-Free DNA Fragm: One of the five posters is titled 'Cell-Free DNA Fragmentome Profiles Predict Immunotherapy Response', presented by Valsamo Anagnostou from Johns Hopkins University on Sunday, April 19.
facts.Poster Presentation: Lung Cancer Subtypi: One of the five posters is titled 'Lung Cancer Subtyping Using Cell-Free DNA Fragmentomes and Protein Biomarkers', presented by Laurel Millberg from DELFI Diagnostics on Sunday, April 19.
facts.Poster Presentation: Clinical Utility of: One of the five posters is titled 'Clinical Utility of Landmark ctDNA Molecular Response as an Early Indicator of Immunotherapy Outcomes in Lung Cancer', presented by Jaime Wehr from Johns Hopkins University on Sunday, April 19.
facts.Poster Presentation: Enhanced cfDNA Frag: One of the five posters is titled 'Enhanced cfDNA Fragmentation-Based Treatment Monitoring on the Ultima Genomics Platform', presented by Laurel Millberg from DELFI Diagnostics on Monday, April 20.
facts.Poster Presentation: DOLPHIN Study on Co: One of the five posters is titled 'Cell-Free DNA Fragmentomes for Treatment Response Monitoring in Patients with Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: The DOLPHIN Study', presented by Denise van Steijn from Netherlands Cancer Institute on Tuesday, April 21.
facts.FirstLook Lung Validation Status: DELFI states that FirstLook Lung has been clinically validated as a blood-based test designed to improve early detection of lung cancer.
facts.FirstLook Lung Negative Predictive Value: The company reports that FirstLook Lung has a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent.
facts.FirstLook Lung Regulatory Status: DELFI explicitly states that FirstLook Lung has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.
facts.DELFI-TF Regulatory Status: DELFI states that the DELFI-Tumor Fraction (DELFI-TF) assay has not been cleared or approved by the FDA and is intended for research use only.

fact_revisions.summary: DELFI将在2026年AACR年会展示5项cfDNA研究，涵盖肺癌早筛、分型及治疗监测。其FirstLook Lung检测NPV达99.8%，但未获FDA批准；DELFI-TF仅限科研用途。
fact_revisions.reason: DELFI通过多癌种临床数据验证全基因组cfDNA平台能力，虽未获批但具备高灵敏度与低成本潜力，对世和构成技术路线竞争威胁。

While it highlights clinical validation data (NPV 99.8%) and new studies (DOLPHIN), these are standard academic updates rather than major regulatory approvals or commercial launches that would significantly alter the competitive landscape immediately. It represents routine dissemination of scientific progress.

events.title: Mirxes and Canhelp Genomics Partner to Advance Cancer Diagnostic in Singapore and the Region

facts.Technology Transfer: Canhelp Genomics will provide its Gene Expression Test System for Human Tumour Origin Identification (Canhelp-Origin) technology to Mirxes.

facts.Clinical Performance: Studies show Canhelp-Origin can identify the origin of over 95% of global tumour types with an accuracy exceeding 90%.
facts.Regulatory Status: Canhelp-Origin is the first and only tumour origin identification test approved by both China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and CE in Europe.
facts.Launch Timeline: The test is expected to be available in Singapore and the region in 1Q 2025.

events.title: After a Positive Noninvasive Colorectal Screening Result, What Happens Next Matters: Geneoscopy Launches ColoSense NextStep

facts.发布 ColoSense NextStep 项目: Geneoscopy 宣布推出 ColoSense NextStep，一个面向 ColoSense 阳性结果患者的提供方启用、自愿加入的患者导航项目
facts.目标随访时间: 项目目标是帮助患者在 ColoSense 阳性结果后 90 天内完成随访结肠镜
facts.支持方式: 经同意后通过短信、邮件或电话联系患者，NextStep 临床支持团队提供随访教育和实用障碍识别，可分享公开的非指令性信息
facts.费用包含: NextStep 费用已包含在每笔 ColoSense 订单中，作为标准患者体验的一部分
facts.ColoSense 现状: ColoSense 是 FDA 批准的多靶点粪便 RNA 检测，用于 45 岁及以上平均风险成人 CRC 筛查，列入 ACS 与 NCCN 指南，并通过与 Labcorp 的商业合作在全国范围提供
facts.背景数据: 一项近 33,000 人的研究显示，粪便筛查阳性者中仅 56% 在一年内接受随访结肠镜
facts.背景风险数据: 研究显示粪便筛查阳性后未完成随访结肠镜与两倍于结直肠癌死亡风险相关

fact_revisions.summary: Geneoscopy于2026年10月20日推出ColoSense NextStep患者导航项目，旨在帮助ColoSense阳性患者在90天内完成随访结肠镜。该项目通过短信、邮件或电话提供教育支持及障碍识别，费用包含在订单中，以解决筛查后随访率低的问题。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和关注理由：竞品完善筛查后闭环服务，提升用户依从性；其FDA获批产品纳入权威指南并绑定Labcorp渠道，构成直接竞争威胁。

rationales.relevance: 结直肠癌非侵入性筛查领域的直接动态（Geneoscopy ColoSense 阳性结果后患者导航服务），属于癌症筛查直接相关；但产品为单癌种粪便 RNA 检测，不直接涉及 MCED 或世和受监测产品。
rationales.impact: ColoSense NextStep 为商业模式实质增强：将费用包含在标准订单中、以 90 天随访结肠镜为目标、依托 Labcorp 全国渠道，直接针对粪便筛查仅 56% 一年内随访的行业痛点，可提升转化与依从性数据，值得纳入竞品档案；但非临床/监管/商业化里程碑，不足以改变格局。
rationales.actionability: 需持续跟踪其导航服务对随访率、成本与支付方价值的实际影响，并更新竞品对照，但无需立即响应。

result.reason: 该证据是Geneoscopy公司发布的新闻稿，宣布推出ColoSense NextStep患者导航计划。这属于受监测产品（ColoSense）相关的商业/运营事件（产品上市/服务发布），符合癌症筛查领域且为具体发生的事件。

events.title: Gene Solutions Hosts Symposium on ctDNA-Guided Breast Cancer Management at the Thai Breast Disease Society Annual Conference 2026

facts.symposium_held: Gene Solutions Thailand hosted a dedicated symposium titled "ctDNA-guided management in breast cancer: from emerging evidence to clinical practice" at the Thai Breast Disease Society Annual Conference 2026 in Bangkok on 19 August 2026.
facts.speaker_external: Dr Harit Suwanrusme, Chief of the Molecular Oncology Division at Horizon Cancer Center, Bumrungrad International Hospital, presented on ctDNA status in breast cancer management.
facts.product_introduction: Gene Solutions Global Medical Affairs Director Ida Deleskog Lindstroem introduced the company's latest multi-omic platform K-4CARE, an AI-powered tissue and liquid biopsy assay integrating genomic, transcriptomic and genome-wide profiling with ultra-sensitive hybrid ctDNA monitoring.
facts.detection_limit: K-4CARE's hybrid tumour-informed and tumour-naive ctDNA approach has a limit of detection of 0.005%.
facts.clinical_context_claim: Evidence discussed showed persistent ctDNA positivity after neoadjuvant therapy is associated with poorer outcomes, while ctDNA clearance may indicate a more favourable response.
facts.survey_result: A concurrent physician survey of 129 respondents indicated breast cancer specialists remain at an early stage of ctDNA adoption, with increasing interest in tumour and liquid biopsy comprehensive profiling and high-sensitivity ctDNA-MRD monitoring solutions such as K-TRACK and K-4CARE.
facts.supporting_evidence_source: Asian real-world evidence presented at ASCO 2026 and ASCO Breakthrough 2026 was cited as supporting the prognostic and predictive value of the multi-omic and hybrid ctDNA approaches in early-stage and metastatic settings.

fact_revisions.summary: 2026年8月19日，世和基因在泰国乳腺癌年会举办专题研讨会，介绍K-4CARE多组学平台。该平台整合组织与液体活检，ctDNA检测限达0.005%。调查显示医生对高灵敏度MRD监测兴趣增加。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和在亚洲推广K-4CARE，强调0.005%超低检测限及多组学优势，直接冲击高端早筛市场，需关注其临床证据落地情况。

rationales.relevance: 肿瘤领域外围相关：内容聚焦乳腺癌治疗期 ctDNA 监测/MRD，而非癌症筛查或 MCED，提及的 K-4CARE/K-TRACK 属监测与精准治疗产品，非受监测早筛产品。
rationales.impact: 属竞品日常市场传播活动（学术会议研讨会、医生调研），虽有 K-4CARE 平台细节（LOD 0.005%、混合 ctDNA），但不构成实质性产品/临床/监管变化。
rationales.actionability: 无需立即行动，但值得持续跟踪 Gene Solutions 在亚洲的多组学/ctDNA 监测布局及其临床转化动向。

result.reason: 该证据描述了Gene Solutions在2026年泰国乳腺疾病学会年度会议上举办的一场关于ctDNA指导乳腺癌管理的专题研讨会。这是一件具体发生的事件（会议披露/活动公告），内容涉及其监测产品K-4CARE和K-TRACK的临床应用、多组学分析以及ctDNA在微小残留病灶（MRD）监测中的作用，与癌症筛查及受监测产品直接相关。

events.title: 燃石医学与Myriad达成全球技术授权战略合作，携手拓展新一代HRD检测全球版图

facts.达成全球技术授权战略合作: 燃石医学与Myriad Genetics, Inc.达成全新的全球技术授权战略合作，共同推动myChoice HRD Plus产品技术拓展。
facts.开发新一代HRD检测试剂盒: 基于燃石医学自主研发的OncoScreen Plus平台搭载全新授权技术，开发新一代HRD检测试剂盒，商业化领域从中国扩大到全球多个核心市场。
facts.历史合作背景: 双方合作始于2020年，当时首次官宣达成独家技术授权战略合作，将Myriad获得FDA批准的HRD基因组不稳定性评分（GIS）算法引入中国。
facts.产品功能扩展: 新的myChoice HRD Plus在保留原有HRD基因组不稳定性评分（GIS）检测基础上新增针对前列腺癌的基因组不稳定性评分（prGIS）算法模块。
facts.授权地域限制: 新合作中，GIS算法授权范围除日本外；prGIS算法授权范围除日本和美国外。

fact_revisions.summary: 燃石医学与Myriad达成全球技术授权合作，拓展myChoice HRD Plus至前列腺癌检测，并基于OncoScreen平台开发新一代HRD试剂盒，商业化范围从中国扩至全球核心市场。
fact_revisions.reason: 该合作强化燃石在HRD领域的全球布局，新增前列腺癌检测模块及新一代试剂盒研发，可能提升其伴随诊断竞争力与市场覆盖。

rationales.relevance: 事件涉及燃石医学（Burning Rock）的HRD检测产品拓展及全球战略合作。虽然HRD检测主要属于伴随诊断（CDx）和精准治疗领域，而非直接的多癌种早期筛查（MCED），但燃石医学是癌症早筛领域的关键竞争者，且其业务涵盖“基于液体活检的多癌种早检”。该合作强化了其在肿瘤基因检测平台（OncoScreen Plus）上的技术积累和全球商业化能力，对理解其整体竞争态势有直接参考价值，故评为癌症筛查直接相关（外围核心）。

events.title: 聚焦首创新药早研与转化，6Dmarker模型或将推动biomarker迈入“自主发现”时代！

facts.演讲人及场合: 吉因加首席医学官陈蓉蓉在2026首创新药早期研发与转化大会专题论坛发表主题演讲
facts.技术背景: 基于2025年自主研发的GenoVision多组学多模态大模型提出6Dmarker模型
facts.核心方法论: 将复杂多模态数据拆解为基因、通路、细胞、个体、群体、知识六大核心生物学维度
facts.配套工具: 配备吉小库Agent（负责标准化数据治理）和吉小研Agent（承担智能化队列分析）双AI引擎
facts.应用场景: 深度嵌入创新药早期研发全链路，覆盖靶点评估、适应症筛选、临床试验决策、伴随诊断布局等场景

fact_revisions.summary: 吉因加于2026年8月发布6Dmarker模型，基于GenoVision大模型，将多模态数据拆解为六大生物学维度，配套双AI引擎，赋能创新药早研全链路及伴随诊断。
fact_revisions.reason: 该模型重构biomarker挖掘框架，推动研发从单点筛选升级为全域智能化建模，具备自主发现潜力，对癌症早筛技术路径有重要参考价值。

rationales.relevance: 该事件涉及吉因加发布的6Dmarker模型，主要聚焦于首创新药早期研发、免疫治疗biomarker挖掘及伴随诊断布局。虽然属于肿瘤精准医疗领域且与筛查技术（多组学/AI）有底层技术关联，但其核心应用场景为药物研发和临床决策支持，而非直接的癌症早筛产品或MCED检测服务，因此判定为肿瘤领域外围相关。
rationales.impact: 这是一次在行业会议上的技术披露，展示了吉因加在AI多组学和biomarker发现方面的最新方法论（6Dmarker）。对于世和基因而言，这反映了竞争对手在底层数据治理和AI建模能力上的日常传播和技术迭代，虽未直接改变市场格局或推出新的筛查产品，但值得纳入竞品档案以跟踪其技术演进路径。
rationales.actionability: 目前无需立即采取商业或临床响应行动。建议持续跟踪吉因加后续是否将该6Dmarker模型转化为具体的早筛产品管线或获得监管批准，并更新内部关于竞争对手AI多组学能力的对照分析。

result.reason: 该证据描述了吉因加（GenePlus）在2026年首创新药早期研发与转化大会上发布/演讲其'6Dmarker模型'这一具体事件。虽然主要聚焦于biomarker挖掘和药物研发，但biomarker是癌症早筛（特别是MCED多癌种早筛）的核心技术基础，且属于受监测产品相关的技术披露/会议活动，符合'具体发生的事'和'与癌症筛查/MCED相关'的条件。

events.title: 中国医学科学院肿瘤医院胸外科谭锋维教授：MRD检测未来可期，看好临床背书的MRD产品

facts.会议背景: 第十一届肿瘤分子病理检测标准化应用及质量控制研讨会于2022年9月16日-18日在北京召开，由国家癌症中心、北京肿瘤学会主办。
facts.演讲主题: 中国医学科学院肿瘤医院胸外科谭锋维教授作了《MRD研究进展和临床应用》的主题报告。
facts.临床价值总结: 谭锋维教授总结了MRD的三大临床价值：预后评估、复发检测、疗效评估，并指出MRD监测可较影像学提前发现复发。
facts.辅助治疗关联: 国内3项大型临床研究证实，术后MRD状态与辅助治疗获益相关；MRD阳性患者从辅助治疗中获益，而MRD阴性患者接受辅助治疗与提高RFS无相关性。
facts.检测时机建议: 根据现有研究，术后MRD检测建议在术后三天到一个月内进行；同步放化疗后的MRD检测建议在治疗后一个月左右进行。
facts.评价指标观点: 谭锋维教授认为理想的MRD检测应追求高敏感性和特异性平衡，需考虑在特定人群前提下选择cut-off以达到预期的NPV和PPV，强调产品应重视临床验证。

fact_revisions.summary: 2022年9月，谭锋维教授在肿瘤分子病理研讨会上分享MRD研究进展。指出MRD具有预后评估、复发检测及疗效评估三大临床价值，可较影像学提前发现复发。国内3项大型临床研究证实术后MRD状态与辅助治疗获益相关。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和作为臻和科技关联品牌，其MRD产品直接受益于该权威专家对“临床背书”的强调及MRD临床应用价值的肯定，有助于提升市场认可度。

rationales.relevance: 内容聚焦于MRD（微小残留病灶）检测的临床应用、预后评估及辅助治疗指导，属于癌症筛查与监测的直接相关领域。虽然主要涉及术后/治疗后监测而非初筛，但MRD技术与多癌种早期筛查（MCED）在液体活检技术路径和临床价值上高度重叠，且文中提及“筛选患者”、“富集患者”等潜在临床应用，符合癌症筛查直接相关的定义。
rationales.impact: 该事件为学术会议上的专家观点分享，总结了现有的临床研究进展和行业共识（如检测时机、评价指标），并未发布新的重大临床试验结果、监管批准或颠覆性的产品数据。对于竞争格局而言，这属于日常传播或小幅更新，有助于完善对MRD市场教育和技术标准的认知，但不构成实质性的竞争壁垒变化。
rationales.actionability: 需要持续跟踪。虽然无需立即响应，但谭锋维教授关于“看好具有临床数据背书的产品”以及MRD检测时机、评价指标的观点，反映了关键意见领袖（KOL）和市场对MRD产品的核心诉求。这些信息可用于更新竞品档案中的市场定位分析、临床验证策略对比以及后续类似会议的情报收集方向。

facts.value: 国内3项大型临床研究证实术后MRD状态与辅助治疗获益相关：MRD阳性患者从辅助治疗中获益，MRD阴性患者接受辅助治疗与提高RFS无相关性

facts.name: MRD检测评价指标框架
facts.value: 评价指标可归为3大类：按技术设计合理性、按与临床结果一致性、按与常规检测的优效性划分；理想MRD检测应追求高敏感性和特异性

facts.name: 专家对MRD产品的态度
facts.value: 谭锋维教授表示市场已出现很多MRD检测产品，但更看好具有临床数据背书的产品，希望企业加强MRD临床应用探索

result.rationale: 两份判断的事实条目均有证据支持，但qwen版更充分：(1)event_type判定为conference_disclosure，与证据（学术会议主题报告新闻）一致，glm误判为clinical_readout（文中无临床试验数据读出事件）；(2)qwen明确标注product为"MRD检测"，与主题吻合，glm留空；(3)qwen对涉及"3项大型临床研究"等临床数字标记了clinical_number风险标志，更审慎。故选择qwen。

relevance.rationale: 内容聚焦于MRD（微小残留病灶）检测的临床应用、预后评估及辅助治疗指导，属于癌症筛查与监测的直接相关领域。虽然主要涉及术后/治疗后监测而非初筛，但MRD技术与多癌种早期筛查（MCED）在液体活检技术路径和临床价值上高度重叠，且文中提及“筛选患者”、“富集患者”等潜在临床应用，符合癌症筛查直接相关的定义。

impact.rationale: 该事件为学术会议上的专家观点分享，总结了现有的临床研究进展和行业共识（如检测时机、评价指标），并未发布新的重大临床试验结果、监管批准或颠覆性的产品数据。对于竞争格局而言，这属于日常传播或小幅更新，有助于完善对MRD市场教育和技术标准的认知，但不构成实质性的竞争壁垒变化。

actionability.rationale: 需要持续跟踪。虽然无需立即响应，但谭锋维教授关于“看好具有临床数据背书的产品”以及MRD检测时机、评价指标的观点，反映了关键意见领袖（KOL）和市场对MRD产品的核心诉求。这些信息可用于更新竞品档案中的市场定位分析、临床验证策略对比以及后续类似会议的情报收集方向。

relevance.rationale: MRD术后微小残留病监测属肿瘤领域外围相关，非MCED早筛核心议题，但与液体活检技术生态相关。

impact.rationale: KOL会议分享，传播MRD临床价值与检测时机观点，属日常传播层面信息，无重大产品或监管进展。

actionability.rationale: 涉及KOL观点与MRD临床验证趋势，值得持续跟踪以更新竞争对照，无需立即响应。

result.rationale: 两份判断在impact与actionability上一致（15/10），分歧仅在relevance。原文明确讨论MRD液体活检检测的临床应用、复发监测、患者筛选与富集等，属癌症检测/监测直接相关内容，qwen的20分及其引用证据支持更充分；glm仅笼统称“外围相关”而未充分回应文中“筛选患者”等直接表述。故采纳qwen。

result.summary: 2022年9月，谭锋维教授在肿瘤分子病理研讨会上分享MRD研究进展。指出MRD具有预后评估、复发检测及疗效评估三大临床价值，可较影像学提前发现复发。国内3项大型临床研究证实术后MRD状态与辅助治疗获益相关。
result.reason: 世和作为臻和科技关联品牌，其MRD产品直接受益于该权威专家对“临床背书”的强调及MRD临床应用价值的肯定，有助于提升市场认可度。

events.title: 《早期肺癌诊断中国专家共识（2023年版）》重磅发布，基准医疗肺癌早诊工具PulmoSeek获推荐用于早期肺癌无创辅助诊断

facts.《早期肺癌诊断中国专家共识（2023年版）》发布: 中华医学会呼吸病学分会制订的该共识在《中华结核和呼吸杂志》2023年第01期发布
facts.PulmoSeek获共识推荐: PulmoSeek（血浆ctDNA多基因甲基化肺结节鉴别诊断工具）获《早期肺癌诊断中国专家共识（2023年版）》推荐，用于早期肺癌诊断
facts.共识推荐意见9内容: 新型肺癌标志物中可选择性进行肺癌血清七种自身抗体、循环肿瘤细胞、循环肿瘤DNA、DNA甲基化及呼出气肺癌标志性成分等检测
facts.PulmoSeek合作方: PulmoSeek由基准医疗与广州医科大学附属第一医院（国家呼吸医学中心）、广州呼吸健康研究院何建行/梁文华教授团队联合开发
facts.多中心临床研究: 2017年6月启动14家研究中心参与的前瞻性采样、回顾性盲法评估临床研究NCT03181490（甲基化监测辅助诊断肺结节多中心临床验证研究）
facts.PulmoSeek Plus性能: 费益检®（PulmoSeek Plus）敏感性高达98.1%、特异性高达91.7%，诊断肺结节良恶性准确率高达97.3%，术前预判高风险肺结节肺腺癌浸润程度准确率高达85.8%
facts.产品线扩展: 基准医疗推出费影检（PulmoInsight）肺结节CT影像AI辅助诊断系统及费镜检（PulmoPath）基于肺泡灌洗液及肺活检组织的肺癌DNA甲基化早诊产品
facts.国际综述引用: CA-A CANCER JOURNAL FOR CLINICIANS发表综述《Cancer epigenetics in clinical practice》，引用基准医疗UriFind和PulmoSeek相关临床研究论文及数据
facts.学术会议报告: PulmoSeek相关研究成果先后在WCLC 2021、ERS International Congress 2022、ESMO Congress 2022、中华医学会2022年全国肺癌学术大会报告

events.title: 喜讯 | 基准医疗PulmoSeek™ 获评为2022年广东省名优高新技术产品

facts.获评2022年广东省名优高新技术产品: 2023年1月13日广东省高新技术企业协会公布名单，PulmoSeek™肺部结节无创诊断基因检测服务被评为2022年广东省名优高新技术产品
facts.欧盟IVDD CE认证: 2022年6月PulmoSeek™通过欧盟IVDD CE认证，获荷兰CIBG当局签发的体外诊断试剂注册许可
facts.专家共识推荐: 2023年1月获写入《早期肺癌诊断中国专家共识（2023年版）》推荐用于早期肺癌无创辅助诊断
facts.费益检（PulmoSeek Plus）性能数字: 敏感性98.1%、特异性91.7%、诊断肺结节良恶性准确率97.3%、术前预判肺腺癌浸润程度准确率85.8%
facts.学术发表: 2021年PulmoSeek研究成果发表于The Journal of Clinical Investigation（IF=19.456）

fact_revisions.summary: 基准医疗PulmoSeek获2022年广东省名优高新技术产品。其Plus版敏感性98.1%、特异性91.7%，已获欧盟IVDD CE认证并写入2023年中国专家共识，研究成果发表于JCI期刊。

events.title: 基准医疗SABCS首发：ctDNA甲基化与乳腺超声联合早诊模型可降低不必要的活检/手术率

facts.SABCS壁报收录: 基准医疗与哈尔滨医科大学附属肿瘤医院庞达教授团队联合发表的《乳腺超声与ctDNA甲基化联合模型可提高乳腺癌早期诊断性能》被2022年12月6-10日举行的SABCS以壁报形式收录并现场展示
facts.BI-RADS 4a准确性提升: 联合模型对BI-RADS 4a类患者的准确性比乳腺超声提高40.58%
facts.不必要活检/手术率降低: 联合模型使BI-RADS 4a类患者不必要的活检/手术率降低43.47%
facts.DCIS/IDC区分潜力: ctDNA甲基化模型对良性病变、DCIS和IDC的恶性概率预测随恶性程度和浸润程度加深而递增，有区分DCIS和IDC的潜力
facts.既往npj Breast Cancer发表: 2021年基准医疗在《npj Breast Cancer》发表外周血游离DNA甲基化乳腺癌诊断模型研究，效果堪比甚至超过乳腺钼靶

fact_revisions.summary: 基准医疗在SABCS展示ctDNA甲基化与超声联合模型，使BI-RADS 4a患者准确性提升40.58%，不必要活检/手术率降低43.47%，并具区分DCIS与IDC潜力。
fact_revisions.reason: 该模型显著降低乳腺癌过度诊疗率，解决BI-RADS 4a高假阳性痛点，具备临床转化价值，值得世和关注其早筛技术进展。

rationales.relevance: 该事件涉及基准医疗在乳腺癌早诊领域的ctDNA甲基化联合超声模型研究，属于癌症筛查直接相关领域。虽然主要聚焦于单癌种（乳腺癌）的辅助诊断以减少过度诊疗，而非多癌种早期检测（MCED），但其技术路径（液体活检+影像）与世和基因等公司的多癌种筛查产品存在潜在的技术交叉和市场关联，故评为20分。
rationales.impact: 这是一项实质性的临床进展披露。SABCS壁报展示及具体数据（准确性提升40.58%，不必要活检率降低43.47%）表明该公司在特定场景下解决了临床痛点（BI-RADS 4a类结节的过度诊疗）。这值得纳入竞品档案，作为其技术能力和差异化定位的证据，但尚未达到改变整体竞争格局或获得重大监管批准的里程碑级别。
rationales.actionability: 需要持续跟踪。目前仅为会议壁报形式的初步学术披露，需关注后续是否有更大规模的前瞻性临床试验、注册申报进展或商业化落地情况，以评估其对世和基因现有产品线或未来布局的实际威胁或合作机会。暂无立即响应的紧迫性。

result.reason: 该证据描述了基准医疗（AnchorDx）在2022年圣安东尼奥乳腺癌研讨会（SABCS）上首次发布的一项具体学术成果。这是一件具体的会议披露事件，涉及ctDNA甲基化与乳腺超声联合模型在乳腺癌早期诊断中的应用及临床数据读出（如降低不必要的活检率），符合癌症筛查/MCED相关且为具体发生的事件这两个条件。

facts.nhs_galleri_promise_barrier: NHS-Galleri trial shows MCED promise but highlights health system readiness as critical barrier

facts.equity_conditions: Achieving equitable impact requires greater diversity in training data, earlier integration into publicly funded health systems, and parallel investment in diagnostic and follow-up capacity

fact_revisions.summary: 综述指出当前癌症筛查协议系统性服务不足低收入及少数群体。新兴技术如多癌种早期检测（MCED）虽具潜力，但成本高且主要限于私营医疗体系，若实施不当可能加剧健康不平等。
fact_revisions.reason: 世和需关注NHS-Galleri试验揭示的公共卫生系统准备度瓶颈，以及MCED技术在公共医疗体系中因成本和可及性限制而面临的公平性挑战。

rationales.relevance: 肿瘤领域综述，直接讨论 MCED 测试与 NHS-Galleri 试验，但非竞争产品本身的直接进展，属癌症筛查直接相关但未涉及具体受监测产品的商业/临床事件。
